ownership_rule: The project owns this database; no application owns it or its table. The letters of words reach it only through the one intermediary of the project database (qnc.module.db-broker), whose table module qnc.module.letter-db owns it.

rules.made: In the background, only for the words a script shows, by the letter aligner of the host (qnc-letter-times).
rules.use: A click on a letter of a statement in the script cues to it; a double click on two letters cuts at them.
